components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is
            one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and is used to compose the
            read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional now that the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields exist; when the structured fields
            are supplied it is composed from them and returned as the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. Supplying this flat form
            remains accepted for backward compatibility. An owner must supply an
            address in at least one form (a non-blank 'addressLine1' or this flat
            'address').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Optional; preferred over the flat 'address' when
            supplied and must be non-blank. Normalized on create (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address
            (unit, suite, etc.). Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and,
            when present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: 'Apt 2B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^\s*\S[\s\S]*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: separators are stripped, a leading '+'
            keeps the supplied country code otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped, and the result must carry 8 to 15
            digits after the '+'. For example '0412 345 678' is stored and
            returned as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '0412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be four
            digits and, for a city whose region is known (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that region's inclusive
            postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
            When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-30'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is used to derive the read-only 'ageBand' and must
            not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.PastOrPresent"
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            shares its household (same last name and postcode). It only bypasses
            the household-duplicate block; the owner is then created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Optional
            and write-only; defaults to false.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw
                'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or null when
                the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in
                the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>',
                where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year derived from
                the business-day-adjusted registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. Each fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest over the owner's normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and its postcode. Owners that share a last
                name and postcode share this value automatically. Null when the
                last name or postcode is absent.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created, i.e. before this create. Zero when the name
                was unique on creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0 and accumulating: 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when the owner had no
                namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of one or more elapsed
                fiscal years (the number of 1-July fiscal-year boundaries
                between the registration date and the current date).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this
                owner's registration date, signalling a bulk-signup surge;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49
                owners (inclusive), signalling that it is approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                True when this owner has been soft-deleted via DELETE
                /api/owners/{id}; the record is retained but flagged deleted and
                is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner was flagged a possible (soft-match)
                duplicate at creation: it was not a hard duplicate, yet it
                shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), or null when it is
                not a possible duplicate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' from 65 on. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a single space
                and the lastName when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Who'), or
                just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256
                digest over
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>' (the
                telephone and email components empty when absent). Two owners are
                considered duplicates only when their whole identity keys are
                equal; a create is rejected with 409 on an exact full-key match
                against an existing owner.
              type: string
              example: '3b8c2f0e1d5a9c7b4e6f8a0d2c1b3e5f7a9c0d2e4f6a8c0b1d3e5f7a9c1b3d5e'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URL of this owner resource, formed as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Null when the owner
                has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0

All requirements are satisfied and the build is green. The only remaining mentions of the old field names are in the acceptance test asserting they've been removed.

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` field formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit`. The test suite passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1/1 tests green).

**What changed:**

- **`model/Owner.java`** — renamed the persisted `customer_code`/`customerCode` field to `member_id`/`memberId` (getter/setter renamed); `primaryIdentifier()` now returns the memberId.

- **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — replaced `generateCustomerCode` with `generateMemberId`, which assembles `REGION + FY + HASH8 + CHK`:
  - `REGION` from the existing postcode/city region derivation,
  - `FY` = 2-digit fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registration date,
  - `HASH8` = the same SHA-256-over-(telephone+lastName) first-8-upper-hex used by the region-and-hash identity,
  - `CHK` = a single Luhn check digit over the digits of `REGION+FY+HASH8` (added a private `luhnCheckDigit` helper).
  - Collision handling now applies to the **memberId** (appends `-<n>` from 2 upward against existing member ids).

- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — removed the `membershipNumber` and `checkDigit` mappings/methods; `formatLocality` now takes the region as the leading letter-run of the memberId (before the FY digits), so `locality` → `timezone` → `ownerSegment` all reference the memberId. `memberId` itself is auto-mapped by name.

- **`audit/OwnerAuditEvents.java`** — the structured `OWNER_CREATED` event's field is renamed `customerCode` → `memberId` (JSON now emits `"memberId"`).

- **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — the human-readable audit line now logs `memberId` and drops `membershipNumber`.

- **`resources/openapi.yml`** — removed the `customerCode`, `checkDigit`, `membershipNumber` schema entries and added a `memberId` entry (regenerates `OwnerDto`).

- **`resources/db/{h2,hsqldb,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — renamed the `customer_code` column to `member_id` and widened it to `VARCHAR(32)` (Postgres `TEXT`) to fit the longer id.

Runtime confirmation from the audit log: `memberId=NSW2716E6609E1` (`NSW` + FY `27` + HASH8 `16E6609E` + CHK `1`), and the structured event `{"seq":1,"ownerId":11,"memberId":"NSW2716E6609E1","membershipLevel":1,"event":"OWNER_CREATED"}`.
